soldiers_buckle.description: A drilled guard-oath steadies your stance just before a blow lands.
soldiers_buckle.rules_text: When a defensive reaction triggers, gain 1 Threshold for that attack.

embershard_focus.description: A disposable ember lens stretches fire beyond its natural reach.
embershard_focus.rules_text: Fire attacks gain +1 Range and +1 Spell Potency.

keen_edge_oil.description: Its first clean cut parts armor before the oil burns away.
keen_edge_oil.rules_text: Your first attack each combat gains +2 Penetration and +1 Attack Power.

healers_brooch.description: Silver leaves unfold when restorative draughts touch the tongue.
healers_brooch.rules_text: Drinking a potion also clears Slow and restores 1 class resource.

quickstep_charm.description: Seven wind-knots tighten after a committed dash.
quickstep_charm.rules_text: After using a movement ability, gain +2 Evasion until your next turn.

amulet_of_vigor.description: Green glass beats like a spare heart when yours falters.
amulet_of_vigor.rules_text: Below half health, gain another +2 Threshold.

duelist_gloves.description: The gloves guide a blade toward whichever opening appears first.
duelist_gloves.rules_text: Against an isolated enemy, gain +2 Accuracy and +1 Penetration.

wand_of_cinders.description: The wand banks heat until magic finds clustered prey.
wand_of_cinders.rules_text: Spell attacks that can hit multiple tiles gain +1 Range.

lucky_coin.description: The coin steals a little probability whenever an attack narrowly misses.
lucky_coin.rules_text: Once per turn, an attack that misses by 2 or less gains +2 Accuracy.

scholars_lens.description: Every enemy defense becomes a lesson written in reflected light.
scholars_lens.rules_text: After an attack is stopped by Threshold or Aegis, gain +1 Penetration for the next attack.

giant_bane_grip.description: The grip tightens around weapons raised against oversized or elite prey.
giant_bane_grip.rules_text: Against elite and boss enemies, gain +3 Penetration.

moonleaf_cloak.description: Moonleaf fibers blur at the edge of an attacker's vision.
moonleaf_cloak.rules_text: While Hidden or before your first attack, gain +2 Armor Class.

aether_prism.description: Each facet converts one school of harm into another angle of force.
aether_prism.rules_text: Arcane attacks gain +1 Range and ignore 1 additional Aegis.

boots_of_the_hare.description: A stored spring releases whenever danger closes from several sides.
boots_of_the_hare.rules_text: While adjacent to two or more enemies, gain +2 Evasion.

sunward_periapt.description: Sunlight pools in the periapt and refuses to let healing go to waste.
sunward_periapt.rules_text: Healing at full health grants 2 temporary Aegis against all damage.

flameheart_talisman.description: The talisman rewards spellcasters who stand close enough to feel the heat.
flameheart_talisman.rules_text: Fire attacks made within 2 tiles gain +2 Spell Potency and +1 Penetration.

kingsroad_aegis.description: A royal ward turns the first wound of every battle into a glancing blow.
kingsroad_aegis.rules_text: The first damaging hit each combat gains 3 Aegis against its damage type.

starfallen_sigil.description: A patient silver star aligns weapon and spell trajectories alike.
starfallen_sigil.rules_text: On a natural 20, restore 1 class resource.

heartwood_crown.description: Living roots harden when their bearer refuses to move.
heartwood_crown.rules_text: If you have not moved this turn, gain +3 Armor Class and +2 Threshold.

ironroot_ring.description: Iron-bound rootwood anchors flesh against forced movement.
ironroot_ring.rules_text: Reduce forced movement by 1 tile and gain +1 physical Aegis.

sparkwire_wrap.description: Copper wire discharges into the first target struck each round.
sparkwire_wrap.rules_text: Your first hit each round deals 2 additional lightning damage.

menders_sachet.description: Bitter herbs release a restorative breath when blood is first drawn.
menders_sachet.rules_text: The first time you fall below half health each combat, heal 3.

windknotted_thread.description: A pale cord pulls its wearer toward unoccupied ground.
windknotted_thread.rules_text: With no adjacent enemies, gain +1 movement and +1 Evasion.

chalk_rune_tablet.description: The rune can be broken to force a spell through resistant wards.
chalk_rune_tablet.rules_text: Your first spell each floor gains +3 Penetration.

scavengers_token.description: The token remembers overlooked corners after a room falls silent.
scavengers_token.rules_text: Clearing a floor grants 3 additional gold for each unopened chest or cache.

drillmasters_whistle.description: One sharp note turns a successful defense into a practiced lesson.
drillmasters_whistle.rules_text: A triggered defensive reaction grants 2 bonus XP and 1 class resource.

brambleguard_clasp.description: Bronze thorns punish anything that presses into the wearer's guard.
brambleguard_clasp.rules_text: When a melee defensive reaction triggers, deal 1 physical damage to the attacker.

stormglass_bead.description: A captive storm leaps farther after movement.
stormglass_bead.rules_text: After moving, lightning attacks gain +1 Range and +2 Spell Potency.

cutpurses_favor.description: The charm pays its bearer for precise, bloodless work.
cutpurses_favor.rules_text: Defeating an enemy while at full health grants 2 additional gold.

redstep_spurs.description: The spurs bite only when their wearer commits to a line of attack.
redstep_spurs.rules_text: After moving at least 2 tiles, gain +2 Attack Power on the next martial attack.

apothecarys_cup.description: Impossible measuring marks make every draught exact rather than merely strong.
apothecarys_cup.rules_text: Potions cannot overheal; unused healing becomes temporary Aegis, up to 3.

veterans_whetstone.description: A scarred whetstone favors repeated blows against the same foe.
veterans_whetstone.rules_text: Consecutive attacks against the same target gain +1 Accuracy and +1 Penetration.

wayfinders_compass.description: Its needle points toward the safest useful square.
wayfinders_compass.rules_text: Movement abilities gain +1 Range; landing unengaged restores 1 class resource.

runebound_bracer.description: A warm rune divides its loyalty between blade and guard.
runebound_bracer.rules_text: After a defensive reaction triggers, your next martial attack gains +2 Accuracy.

glass_magus_eye.description: The lens exposes the thinnest seam in magical resistance.
glass_magus_eye.rules_text: Spell attacks gain Penetration equal to half their Range bonus.

pilgrims_greaves.description: The greaves harden with every deliberate step.
pilgrims_greaves.rules_text: After moving at least 2 tiles, gain +2 Threshold until your next turn.

gilded_beetle.description: The jeweled beetle wakes whenever fortune produces an excess.
gilded_beetle.rules_text: Gold pickups of 10 or more restore 1 class resource.

saints_phial.description: The empty phial preserves the echo of healing for the next wound.
saints_phial.rules_text: After drinking a potion, gain 2 Aegis against the next damage type received.

war_scholars_codex.description: Margins compare monster anatomy with diagrams of battle magic.
war_scholars_codex.rules_text: After first hitting an enemy, gain +1 Attack Power and Spell Potency against that enemy.

blackoak_ward.description: Blackoak is too dense to yield to weak blows.
blackoak_ward.rules_text: Physical damage stopped by Threshold restores 1 class resource.

phoenix_ash_reliquary.description: Uncooling ash kindles when healing would otherwise be too late.
phoenix_ash_reliquary.rules_text: Once per floor, lethal damage leaves you at 1 health and ignites adjacent enemies.

wyvernscale_mantle.description: Overlapping scales turn poison and blades in different ways.
wyvernscale_mantle.rules_text: When poison damage is fully absorbed, gain +2 Attack Power next turn.

chronomancers_pin.description: Its hands twitch backward at the instant an action goes wrong.
chronomancers_pin.rules_text: Once per combat, reroll a missed attack and keep the new result.

deepdelvers_lantern.description: Pale flame reveals danger and treasure in equal measure.
deepdelvers_lantern.rules_text: Against undiscovered enemy types, gain +2 Accuracy and +2 Armor Class.

titanblood_torc.description: A bronze second pulse turns pain into crushing force.
titanblood_torc.rules_text: Below half health, gain +3 Attack Power but lose 1 Evasion.

crown_of_the_first_flame.description: The first flame refuses resistance and feeds on fallen magic.
crown_of_the_first_flame.rules_text: Fire attacks convert half of prevented damage into bonus damage on the next spell.

worldbreaker_gauntlet.description: Its runes turn excess force into fractures that outlast the blow.
worldbreaker_gauntlet.rules_text: Martial hits reduce the target's Threshold by 1 for the rest of combat.

fortune_eaters_idol.description: The idol consumes lucky outcomes and returns them as escalating rewards.
fortune_eaters_idol.rules_text: Natural 20s grant 3 gold; natural 1s consume 3 gold to reroll when possible.

aegis_of_the_last_king.description: A broken royal seal remembers a kingdom that refused every kind of ruin.
aegis_of_the_last_king.rules_text: A triggered reaction doubles Aegis against that attack and heals 2 afterward.

charred_horseshoe.description: A smoke-black iron shoe that still remembers the open road.
charred_horseshoe.rules_text: After crossing a Field-room doorway, gain +1 Evasion until your next turn.

harvesters_gloves.description: Warding straw and copper thread guide both steel and spell through chaff.
harvesters_gloves.rules_text: Against an enemy standing beside a destructible prop, gain +2 Accuracy.

cinderheart_locket.description: The Farmstead's last clean ember flares when its bearer is nearly spent.
cinderheart_locket.rules_text: Below half health, gain 2 fire Aegis and restore 1 additional health from consumables.
